_doc: FL-eval: labeled golden set for classify_intent.py (scripts/classify_intent.py). Covers canonical, paraphrase, and adversarial phrasings per intent class. 'known_gap: true' marks cases the current keyword classifier is expected to FAIL today — kept as regression targets for a future semantic-boundary upgrade, not skipped.
_source_hash_doc: sha256 of scripts/classify_intent.py as of the last regeneration of this golden set. TEST-003 (tests/eval/test_golden_file_freshness.py) fails if this drifts from the live file's hash, signaling scenarios need review/regeneration.
